structured_output.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged: none. Cleared: all 8 (r01 to r08).
Checks: on every run, rigid-body invariance and closure passed. Plane sections passed on r01 to r04, r07 and r08. It was not run on r05 and r06 because they report the width-free ratio. No run has a roll back.
r05: its centre REGR peak is 111.88 %/h, about 2.1 times the batch median of 53.27 %/h. Its strain-rate profile has the same shape as the others: peak at 421 µm and growth zone of 695 µm, both at the batch median. Its flank difference scales by the same factor as r04's, and its stride is 1, so nothing changed the time base. The kept remedy (width-free ratio) is the normal path. This reads as a faster-growing root, not a fault.
r01 and r07: the growth zone is 21 µm shorter (674 against 695 µm) and the flank difference has the opposite sign (-0.81 against +0.55 %/h). Their large |z| values come from a near-zero batch MAD, and both differences are small against a REGR of about 53 %/h. Plane sections still passed, so the curvature rate is consistent with the flank difference.
What the flagged runs have in common: nothing, because no run was flagged.
